title: The Springer RV Park and Campground
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We are a small 34 spot RV Park and Campground located just under three miles from downtown Palmer in the historic agricultural district. The Springer road system winds between potato, carrot, barley, and hay fields bordered by a panorama of towering mountains. Our RV Park and Campground enjoys majestic views of the iconic Pioneer Peak on a comforting backdrop of still-in-use farm land.
